duty. 6.: There will be no weekly off day as such. The actual daily payment will be paid on the basis of hire char ges. 7. In case of sickness/emergency/injury/unfitness or inability of the drivers to continue performing their dut y Safely and Satisfactorily to the concerned officer, the Railway reserves the right to demand a change of Driver at anytime. Accordingly, it will be the duty of Contractor to make available suitable alternative drive r to the satisfaction of concerned officer or his authorized representative thereof within 1 hour failing whic h the Railway reserves the right to impose suitable penalty as determined by DRM (W)/RNY. 8.: In case of break down, vehicles will have to be replaced within 1 (one) hour and if vehicles are not provi ded within such period, suitable penalty as determined by DRM (W)/RNY for the entire period for which the vehicle/suitable replacement in lieu thereof is not made available to the Railways may be imposed upon th e contractor by the Railways. 9.: It would be contractors responsibility to pay any damage/compensation arising out of any accident. Rail ways shall not reimburse any of such payment made by contractor. The contractor shall abide by all statut ory regulation like PF Scheme, Employees State Insurance Act, Motor Vehicles Act and Other Rules etc. 11.: Railway will have no liability for vehicles or driver in case of any accident due to any cause. 12.: Railway will have right to impose suitable penalty as determined by DRM (W)/RNY in case of late/non-a vailability of vehicle demand. 13.: Vehicle will be maintained to the highest standard. In case of any failure on road, Railway will have rig ht to impose suitable penalty as determined by DRM (W)/RNY. 14.: The vehicle must turn up within half an hour in case emergencies even in off duty hours. The Contract or must provide Mobile/Land line No. to concerned officer wherein the call is to be made in off duty hours. I n case the vehicle does not turn up within half an hour, the Railway can engage other vehicle for the work and Contractor will be penalized double the cost of paid by the Railways. In case of emergencies, the drive rs may have to perform round the clock duty for which the Contractor will arrange the relief. The contracto r will be paid the normal charges as quoted by him deducting free charges even in case of emergencies. N o extra charges will be paid in case of emergencies and the vehicle called in off hours for important Railwa y work. 15. The Hired vehicle must have restarted commercial guide lines. 16. Toll tax or charges pay by agency. Performance Guarantee (P.G) The procedure for obtaining Performance Guarantee is outlined below: (a)The successful bidder shall have to submit a Performance Guarantee (PG) within 15 (Twenty one) days from the date of issue of Letter of Acceptance ( LOA). Extension of time for submission of PG beyond 15 (Fifteen) days and upto 90 days from the date of issue of LOA may be given by the Authority who is co mpetent to sign the contract agreement. However, a penal interest of 15% per annum shall be charged for the delay beyond 21(Twenty one) days, i.e. from 15 th day after the date of issue of LOA. Further, if the 60th day happens to be a de clared holiday in the concerned office of the Railway, submission of PG can be a ccepted on the next working day.
In all other cases, if the Contractor fails to submit the requisite PG even after 90 days from the date of issue of LOA, the contract is liable to be terminated.
